subject: Logic
title: Tragedy of the Commons
description: A quick, practical guide to Tragedy of the Commons.

hook.text: Each herder adds one more cow to shared pasture. Individually smart. Collectively, the field is destroyed.

buildup.text: Garrett Hardin described this in 1968: rational self-interest can destroy shared resources.

discovery.text: Oceans, atmosphere, groundwater—all commons vulnerable to overuse when individuals bear only a fraction of the cost.

twist.text: Elinor Ostrom showed communities can manage commons without privatization—through trust, rules, and enforcement.

climax.text: The experiment reveals that individual and collective rationality can be at war—and neither wins automatically.

punchline.text: Everyone's rational. The field's still dead.

quiz.question: What does the tragedy of the commons illustrate?
options: Individual rationality can destroy shared resources
